description: PARAMETERS through QueryDef.Parameters (R-SQL-3 metadata and parameters). Saved QParam (pK Long, pT Text(10)): reads Parameters (Name, Type, Direction, Value) and QueryDef.Fields before assignment; OpenRecordset with nothing assigned; assigns pK = 2 and pT = 'zz', opens a dynaset and reads it; assigns pK = 3 and calls Requery on the held recordset, rereading it; opens again with pK as Text "4" and as "abc". Asks each result and the parameter values at the end.
